::: typewriter
Dear Mr Platt,

I write to you plainly. The viewing figures for After Hours Haunts have fallen every week since October. The board has looked at them with me.

Unless your Christmas special on 23 December brings the viewers back, After Hours Haunts will end in January.

The special goes out live, from three o'clock until a quarter past four. Find us a place and a story that the whole country will talk about. Our engineers will wire the target figure to your van once you have a location.

I wish you luck. You will need it.

Yours sincerely,

H. Pike
Head of Programmes
:::

::: stamp
CROWN TELEVISION. PRIVATE.
:::
